excerpt: Is Telesin legit, and is its action camera and phone camera gear worth buying? Who makes it, what the ratings on its store say, what it costs, the 30-day return rules and who it suits.

lede: Telesin makes accessories for action cameras and phones: waterproof cases, floating sticks, selfie sticks, chest and neck mounts, grips and lights for GoPro, DJI and Insta360 cameras and for iPhone and Android phones. It sells on its own store at telesinstore.com and through other sellers. Here's who makes it, what customers say, what it costs and what the warranty and return rules say.

parts: Telesin is a real company: Shenzhen Telesin Digital Co., Ltd., founded in 2013, with its own factory in Dongguan, China. Its store publishes shipping, return and warranty policies, and its most-reviewed products are rated between 4.8 and 5 out of 5 on its own product pages. Most items cost $14 to $64, a fraction of the camera brands' own accessories. The two things to know before you buy: shipping usually takes 2 to 4 weeks, and the return policy excludes sale items.
On November 18, 2026, telesinstore.com sorted its range into camera gear and phone gear.

parts: The reviews on Telesin's store are mostly short and positive. Buyers of the GoPro case say it kept water out at sea and costs far less than GoPro's own housing; buyers of the 3m selfie stick praise it for filming underwater; and several reviewers mention quick email replies from support.

We found no reviews under four stars on these product pages, which is worth keeping in mind: the reviews are shown by the store itself. The milder comments we read were about delivery (one buyer said the case took a long time to arrive) and weight (one said the diving phone case is a little heavy to use out of the water).

Yes. The store's About page says Telesin is owned by Shenzhen Telesin Digital Co., Ltd., founded in 2013, with headquarters in Shenzhen, a registered address in Wan Chai, Hong Kong, and its own factory in the Dalang Innovation Industrial Park in Dongguan. It lists 248 intellectual property items, including 6 invention patents, and says it works with DJI, Insta360 and other camera brands.

The store publishes a shipping policy, a 30-day return policy and a one-year warranty, and gives support email addresses with hours (Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 6:30 PM, China time). People also search "telesin store" with a country name: Telesin is sold by many shops and marketplaces, but its warranty page says it can only give after-sales support for orders on its official website.

For GoPro and DJI owners, Telesin gear costs much less than the camera brands' own accessories: a waterproof case for GoPro Hero 9 to 13 is $13.99, a floating stick $24.99 and a chest belt $13.99. The phone gear is pricier, with the Master Grip Kit for iPhone 18 Pro at $71.99 and kits with lenses up to $229.99.

The trade-offs are time and returns. Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 4 weeks, so order well before a trip, and the return policy excludes sale items, which on November 18, 2026 covered most of the store. If you're unsure an item fits your camera or phone, check the model list on its page first.

parts: Telesin suits GoPro, DJI and Insta360 owners who want cases, floats and mounts without paying camera-brand prices, snorkelers and divers on a budget, and phone filmmakers who want a grip or a neck mount. It's a poor fit if you need gear next week, or if you want to be able to return an item bought on sale.

faq: Is Telesin legit?
Yes. Telesin is owned by Shenzhen Telesin Digital Co., Ltd., founded in 2013, which runs its own factory in Dongguan, China. Its store publishes shipping, return and warranty policies.
Is Telesin a good brand?

Its most-reviewed products are rated 4.8 to 5 out of 5 on its own store, led by a GoPro waterproof case at 4.96 from 80 reviews on November 18, 2026. Those ratings come from the store's own review app.
Is Telesin worth it?
For action camera owners, often yes: a GoPro waterproof case is $13.99 and a floating stick $24.99, far less than camera-brand accessories. Allow 2 to 4 weeks for standard shipping.

We couldn't check it on November 18, 2026: Trustpilot showed an access check to our browser. The ratings in this review come from Telesin's own product pages.
How good is the Telesin GoPro waterproof case?
On Telesin's store it was rated 4.96 out of 5 from 80 reviews on November 18, 2026, with no review under four stars. It costs $13.99, or $17.99 with three filters.
What does Telesin sell?
Accessories for action cameras and phones: waterproof cases, floating sticks, selfie sticks and tripods, chest, neck and bike mounts, phone grips and lights.
Where is Telesin based?
In Shenzhen, China, with a factory in Dongguan and a registered address in Wan Chai, Hong Kong.
Does Telesin have a warranty?
Yes, one year on orders from the official website. In the first 3 months a faulty product is refunded or replaced; from 3 to 6 months the same applies but you pay shipping.
What is Telesin's return policy?
You can request a return within 30 days of receiving an item, unused and in its original packaging. The policy says sale items and gift cards can't be returned.
How long does Telesin shipping take?
Orders leave within 1 to 3 business days. Standard shipping usually takes 2 to 4 weeks and express about 7 to 15 days for $25 to $35. Orders over $79 ship free.
